expectedRealization.rationale: November demand, 1-9M company earnings and low forward valuation should remain testable through the next monthly-sales and reporting cycle.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: Sany combined +45.9% 1-9M revenue, +170.9% profit, +26.9% operating cash flow, +54% Jan-Nov excavator sales and ~9.2x 2019E PE.

changeHypothesis.summary: Infrastructure support strengthened while excavator demand and leader share remained positive, but the cycle was explicitly moving from high growth to high-base steady growth. The opportunity depends on leader earnings/share and valuation rather than assuming a new early-cycle boom.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Replacement, policy-supported infrastructure, leader share and localization can persist across several quarters even as industry growth moderates.
disconfirmingEvidence: Industry language explicitly described a move to high-base steady growth.
Broad machinery equities had already outperformed the falling market.
A mature cycle can compress peak earnings multiples.
